description: Given a Prefect Fivetran integration (FivetranConnector block plus trigger_sync_and_wait_for_completion), convert the connector sync into a single FIVETRAN Sync task in Orchestra pipeline YAML — carrying over the connector_id slug verbatim and representing the API key/secret via a connection: reference rather than inlined.

evals.prompt: Convert this Prefect flow to an Orchestra pipeline task (see files/single_connector_sync.py). Write the pipeline YAML to pipeline.yml in the current directory — no live sync, no deploy.
evals.expected_output: A single FIVETRAN task (integration_job FIVETRAN_SYNC_ALL) with parameters.connector_id: bronzing_regularly carried over verbatim from the source comment, and a connection: reference standing in for the 'fivetran-prod' FivetranConnector.load(...) block's api_key/api_secret, never a literal API key/secret in the YAML.

assertions.text: connector_id bronzing_regularly is carried over verbatim
connector_id is a slug, not a UUID — no UUID-formatted value is invented in its place
A single Orchestra task represents both the FivetranConnector.load(...) block and the trigger_sync_and_wait_for_completion() call — there is no separate two-step trigger/poll modeling

evals.prompt: Convert this Prefect flow to Orchestra pipeline tasks (see files/fivetran_then_dbt.py). Write the pipeline YAML to pipeline.yml in the current directory — no live sync, no deploy.
evals.expected_output: Two tasks: a FIVETRAN task with parameters.connector_id: quietly_frontier, and a DBT_CORE/DBT_CORE_EXECUTE task running 'dbt build --select tag:daily;' with project_dir: dbt_project, where the dbt task's depends_on references the Fivetran task so the dbt build only runs after the sync completes.

assertions.text: connector_id quietly_frontier is carried over verbatim
A DBT_CORE task is present alongside the Fivetran task
The dbt task runs the DBT_CORE_EXECUTE job
The dbt build command with its --select flag is preserved
At least one depends_on list is populated with a reference rather than left empty everywhere

The dbt task's depends_on wires it after the Fivetran sync task (by task id or stage), reflecting that the dbt build in the source only runs once the sync above it has completed — the Fivetran sync and the dbt build are modeled as two separate tasks, not collapsed into one, and not left as unrelated/parallel tasks lacking the dependency link the source's sequential flow implies
